interactables.name: Coco
interactables.text: The Socialite, [Coco], lowers her sunglasses exactly one centimeter. 'Oh thank GOD. Someone with cheekbones.' She pats the sun lounger. You do not sit on it. She respects that.

topics.prompt: Pose beside her chaise, chin up
topics.text: 'Iconic. ICONIC.' She reaches for her phone, then remembers it is evidence now and pouts. 'Tonight is ruined anyway. Some crew person lugged [huge black cases] through the garden at, like, [quarter to seven]. Walked STRAIGHT through my sunset shot. The nerve. The NERVE.'

'It is a spritz, darling, and it is [warm now]. Like everything else about this evening.' She swirls it sadly. 'You know what I keep thinking about? The cases had [little squeaky wheels]. Rrr, rrr, rrr, all the way up the garden path. Some of us were trying to VIBE.'

She peers over her sunglasses at the page beneath you. 'Seven o'clock, library, audio setup? Honey.' A long, slow sip. 'At quarter to seven that man was doing CARDIO through the begonias with two giant cases. [I know what I saw]. I was bored enough to be reliable.'

interactables.name: Coco's Phone
interactables.text: Coco's phone has a pool selfie timestamped [6:47 PM]. In the blurry background, a [figure with large dark cases] rolls up the garden path. And at the very edge of the frame, half-hidden behind the potting shed: a [straw hat], peeking.
A production schedule left poolside. Under '7:00 PM - Crew Assignments:' it reads: '[D. Marsh - Library (audio setup)].'

An enormous body of water, glittering with menace. You maintain a professional distance of exactly one pounce plus a safety margin. In the filter floats [a single bright feather]. It could have blown in from anywhere. The pool is not a suspect, but you don't trust it either.

localDeductionSentence: [Coco's Sighting] and the [Timestamped Photo] agree: big dark cases crossed the garden before the [Production Schedule] says setup even began.
